main_results.result: Forward-only replay authorization remains non-default and pins the historical attempt ledger. It requires a trusted pre-score determinism contract and exposes the exact authorization-bound request binding required for RESERVE, score launch and SLOT.

Added an allowlisted version registry for pre-score runtime provenance. Historical/no-contract stays historical; existing schema-v1 resolves only the exact frozen compliance binding; schema-v2 recognizes replay_authorized_v1 only by exact binding_id/digest. Unknown ids, digest mismatch and v1/v2 downgrade/upgrade mismatches fail closed.

Added a version-aware runtime-provenance auditor that delegates scientific SLOT/COMMIT compliance to the frozen base auditor, then enforces the ADMIT-selected runtime binding. Provenance failure forces score=1 and disables recovery reconciliation.

validated_contracts: No-contract historical ADMITs are not reinterpreted by contract registry v2 or auditor v2.
Existing schema-v1 ADMITs are accepted only against the exact current compliance_runtime_v1 RESERVE binding.
New schema-v2 replay ADMITs can select only the allowlisted replay_authorized_v1 binding whose digest includes auth facade blob f21613ebb6db487d70983ad46caf063ac86c804b.
Caller-supplied arbitrary runtime bindings are rejected; registry authority is canonicalized internally and callers receive mutation-isolated copies.
Replay-v2 ADMIT with missing/v1 RESERVE provenance fails closed; v1 ADMIT with replay-v2 RESERVE also fails closed.
Runtime-provenance mismatch cannot be repaired by adding a COMMIT: v2 auditor sets scientific score to 1 and reconcilable=false before close.
Base scientific reservation compliance remains the lower-layer authority; v2 auditor changes only provenance selection/enforcement.
measurement_validity_rules: A runtime provenance upgrade must be selected in ADMIT before scoring and resolved from an allowlisted version registry, not inferred from whatever RESERVE implementation later happened to run.
Version compatibility is asymmetric and explicit: historical, v1 and replay-v2 are distinct predicates; none is silently upgraded or downgraded.
Provenance mismatch is a scientific failure, not metadata debt, because it means the score was generated under a runtime authorization predicate different from the one frozen pre-score.
Recovery reconciliation is permitted only for base-scientifically valid, provenance-valid slots. Provenance-failed slots are not reconcilable even if a bound SLOT exists.
FAIL_CLOSED remains the default runtime path until the CLOSE/replay layer recognizes the new contract/auditor version end to end.
scope_limitations: Contract-registry and auditor tests used injected exact-shape test doubles around frozen source contracts; the full sibling runtime graph has not yet been byte-executed with these new modules.
No active/default runtime has been changed to use schema-v2 replay authorization.
No new CLOSE/replay module exists yet for schema-v2, so replay-authorized blocks must not be launched in the active V3 path.
Trusted determinism certification remains an independent prerequisite; provenance versioning does not itself prove determinism.
frontier: Implement superseding CLOSE/replay v3 that can replay three durable histories without reinterpretation: historical/no-contract, current schema-v1 runtime-provenance CLOSE, and new schema-v2 replay-authorized CLOSE.

For schema-v2 ADMITs, allow only the new v2 auditor/reporting binding and reject downgrade to current-v1 or historical CLOSE; for schema-v1 preserve the current-v1 close path; preserve already-durable historical/current CLOSE replay exactly.

Then implement a replay-authorized compliance runtime whose ADMIT contract, RESERVE provenance and auditor expected binding all use replay_authorized_v1, while FAIL_CLOSED remains on the current V3-compatible path.
Only after full CLOSE/replay and crash/restart tests, persist a ProcessStableRuntime V4 surface that rejects deterministic replay on generic APIs and exposes only pre-score-authorized replay methods.
Materialize the exact sibling graph and run byte-execution plus deterministic/stochastic inference traces at the declared protected statistic.
exact_next_action: Implement reservation_compliance_close_replay_runtime_provenance_v3 as a forward-only superseding replay layer. Its recover() must accept already-durable historical binding and current-v1 runtime-provenance binding exactly as before, accept the new v2 auditor binding only when the active ADMIT resolves to replay_authorized_v1, and reject every downgrade/cross-version CLOSE. Its prepare_close() should be restricted to recognized schema-v2 replay_authorized_v1 ADMITs and use auditor v2.
